M-WIDGET-MODELS.Purpose: Schema contract between analysis and emission: the widget/property/structure models produced by M-REACTIVITY-ANALYZER and consumed by M-WIDGET-EMITTER.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: WidgetModel and StructureModel: widget identity, hierarchy, usings, members.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: PropertyModel with PropertyKind and Reactivity flags: per-property analysis verdict.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: TypeIdentity and Initializer: type reference and construction description.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Extraction of models from source — owned by M-REACTIVITY-ANALYZER.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Consumption of models into generated code — owned by M-WIDGET-EMITTER.

Principles.PRIN-001: Models are passive data: no Roslyn dependencies leak past analysis, no emission logic inside.

Requirements.REQ-001: The model schema evolves only through coordinated change of M-REACTIVITY-ANALYZER.REQ-001 and M-WIDGET-EMITTER.IN-001.
Requirements.REQ-002: PropertyKind has only Fvp, Prop, State and InheritedContext. SlotOwner stores the original declaration owner as a string, without Roslyn objects or a separate layout category.

Inputs.IN-001: analysis verdicts: extraction output filling the models.

Outputs.OUT-001: widget models: complete description of a widget sufficient for emission.
